    Candidate rows killed by two (Lemma B.2 on a periodic star model) #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex (proof of lem:integral-mesh-cokernels): "The proofs of Lemmas A.1 and A.2 apply over 𝒪 without change … Lemma A.2 gives a surjection from the twisted trace module over 𝒪 onto the integral derivative cokernel."

    Over any commutative coefficient ring: on a periodic star model, if the twisted trace of a word W₀ is killed by two in every twisted trace module, then so is the class of its candidate row (star_two). The coefficients are first normalized (Lemma A.1, which divides only by units); the candidate row is then the trace of W₀.

    def MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.ScalarMeshCategory.TwoRows {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] (Q : TranslationQuiver V) [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] [DecidableEq V] (S : RowSet Q) :
    Prop

    Rows killed by two over every coefficient ring (the form of Lemma B.2 used here): for all coefficients c over a commutative ring O, twice the class of each row is zero.
